entries_new.story: New Clark City is one of the 353 places in the New Cities Map, a database of contemporary new cities commissioned by the Charter Cities Institute and built by the Adrianople Group in Philippines. The database records only the name and location of each city; it carries no founding date, population, developer or legal status, and the About page says data collection is complete for North America, South America and India only. A new city of this kind is built inside an existing country's law. Being planned and purpose-built does not by itself give it rules of its own.
